_about: Public-domain Hugh Price Hughes (1847-1902), Wesleyan Methodist leader of the West London Mission and editor of the Methodist Times, for the Word Hoard: Social Christianity (1889), The Philanthropy of God (1890), Ethical Christianity (1892) and Essential Christianity (1894). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 59 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
